name: design
description: Product-design topology — design-lead + 5 workers (ux-architect, visual-designer, design-system-keeper, prototyper, design-critic) that turn a feature brief into a design spec engineering can build from. Path-lock keyed to docs/design/**; produces artifacts, never code. Prototyper is the sole holder of Gamma/Canva MCP tools. Both a linear command and a per-column lifecycle (via board-flow). Requires common@cepa.
